components.name: Readiness gate
components.inputs: Source hashes, external G1 decision, exact G2approval, G3attestation and exact-source G4results; no secrets
components.outputs: Non-exportable capability bound to target/source/deadline/cleanup, or denial
components.decision_owner: Own sole live-execution admission; reject incomplete G1-G4 before ANY network including SDK initialization
components.errors_and_stop: Missing/stale/contradictory source or approval denies before dispatch; only fixed allowed error category
components.cleanup: No pre-login cleanup; invalidate capability on terminal stop
components.trust: Owner controls reviewed code/environment; gate cannot independently authenticate owner or prove production policy

components.name: Private inputs
components.inputs: Owner-only credential/public-client-key/factor/TOTP provider after readiness; synthetic provider offline
components.outputs: Ephemeral fixture-scoped private handles, never public raw strings
components.decision_owner: Bind two existing fixtures and enrolled verified TOTP; no discovery/enrollment/app-session reuse
components.cleanup: Dispose references in finally, no file/history/clipboard; no cryptographic zeroization claim
components.trust: Private owner process, no agent/remote desktop/recorded terminal access; trusted input code

components.name: Frozen SDK adapter
components.inputs: Pinned2.117.3 factory, guarded fetch, private handles and immutable explicit token
components.outputs: Private user/claims snapshots and bounded errors; no raw public output
components.decision_owner: Explicit same-token getUser/getClaims; persistence/refresh/URL-session discovery disabled; no keys/JWKS/allowExpired override
components.errors_and_stop: Initialization or hidden unapproved traffic/error/partial proof stops; no verifier downgrade or guessed path
components.cleanup: Separate in-memory client per fixture; dispose timers/subscriptions; retain proved owned cleanup handles only
components.trust: Exact frozen-SDK transport call inventory and branch evidence required; mocked SDK sequences alone do not establish actual behavior

components.name: Default-deny transport
components.inputs: Operation descriptor, SDK request and immutable run/case/cleanup capability
components.outputs: Private allowed response or pre-dispatch denial; bounded atomic counters
components.decision_owner: Own rawURL/method/query/phase/factor binding, redirect denial and every operation/request/time budget
components.errors_and_stop: Noncanonical/unclassified request, missing permit, limit or deadline denies before DNS/socket/delegate
components.cleanup: Abort measurement and invalidate late epochs; only owned E5 within reserved original budget remains
components.trust: Guarded delegate sole I/O path; offline process-level deny tripwires supplement injection; abort is not server rollback

components.name: Three-case state machine
components.inputs: Private fixture/case handles and explicit-token evidence, monotonic clock
components.outputs: Derived case scalars and owned-session cleanup handles only
components.decision_owner: Exactly three canonical cases, immutable token each; ES256 rejection-only header routing; subject/session/expiry/freshness rechecked after await
components.errors_and_stop: Unexpected role/anonymous/mismatch/expiry/algorithm/endpoint/provider restriction stops; no refresh/legacy workaround
components.cleanup: Finally retain known new sessions for cleanup; uncertain login cannot invent ownership; suppress stale callbacks
components.trust: Empty factors never prove completeness; header/JWKS fetch never proves crypto path; identity is not writable-session authority

components.name: Closed sanitizer
components.inputs: Bounded own-data evidence snapshots and canonical schema, not arbitrary executable objects
components.decision_owner: Construct fresh whitelist aggregates before rendering; reject unknown/accessor/inherited/nested raw values
components.errors_and_stop: No raw object/error/stack/header/URL/canary diagnostic; sanitizer failure withholds findings
components.cleanup: Release raw references on all exits; no persistent diagnostic artifacts
components.trust: Trusted SDK; parse network data as boundedJSON. Proxies/executable inputs unsupported; inspection can invoke Proxy traps, cannot claim arbitrary code neutralization

components.name: Owned-session cleanup
components.inputs: Ledger of at most2proved newly created probe sessions and their own credentials, reserved budget
components.outputs: Only cleanup NOT_STARTED/DONE/UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and disposal result
components.decision_owner: E5local only, once per owned handle; never global/others/admin/session-row/service-role
components.errors_and_stop: Missing/unknown ownership, timeout/provider failure or unconfirmed scope stops and withholds release
components.cleanup: Duplicate invocation locally idempotent; uncertain attempted request consumes slot; dispose all clients/timers; no JWT-revocation guarantee
components.trust: AAL2 replacement credential must prove same enrolled session; unexpected new session never grants third logout

components.name: Owner output review
components.inputs: Closed aggregate pair, confirmed cleanup and future exact approved render schema
components.outputs: Manual owner-approved release decision only; no upload/write/CLI
components.decision_owner: Owner inspection before sharing; no raw dump or automatic publication
components.errors_and_stop: Missing approval/cleanup/serializer/sanitizer failure withholds release; NOT_RUN template not findings
components.cleanup: Raw handles disposed; post-run sanitized review cannot resume Auth or extend deadlines
components.trust: Owner-private display; outer serialization is a proposed G2decision, not specified/approved by0063
